_comment: Default model profiles used as a fallback when an admin has not set meta.profile on a model. Rules are matched against the model id (and name) top-to-bottom; LATER matches override EARLIER ones field-by-field, so keep broad patterns first and more specific patterns below. A `match` of '*' matches everything; otherwise it is a case-insensitive substring match, or a glob when it contains '*'. Axes (speed/quality) are 1-3. `origin` is the region the model comes from ('EU', 'US' or 'CN'), shown as a flag. `local` is whether the model runs on our own infrastructure; when false a data-warning sign is shown. `eco` shows the green leaf badge.
